name: dojo-tally
description: Count returns, not dispatches: when a fan-out settles, the model hears what came back (returned, failed, silent, unchecked), and /refute sends a report to a judge.

min_wave.title: Minimum wave size
min_wave.description: Only report a settled fan-out when it had at least this many agents.

settle_note.title: Tell the model when a fan-out settles
settle_note.description: Append one meta row to the conversation with the tally and each non-returned agent when a wave settles.
